scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && cp apps/web/src/index.html apps/web/dist/index.html && cp apps/web/src/styles.css apps/web/dist/styles.css
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
